name: Skill Discovery
description: Detects capability gaps in conversation and runs the full skill lifecycle: find on ClawHub → security check → install → list → live update. Broadcasts lifecycle events so UI clients can visualize each stage.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Allow the model to discover and install new skills from ClawHub during chat.

autoInstall.label: Auto Install
autoInstall.help: Install matched skills automatically after security check passes. Off = require operator approval.

broadcastEvents.label: Broadcast Lifecycle Events
broadcastEvents.help: Emit plugin.skill.lifecycle.* WebSocket events so UI clients can visualize each stage.
